title: Do indie devs use AI
author: Content-Option-2365
selftext: Hey, I have a question are game asset generators something that indie devs actually use? Because I have just created one and I'm wondering who to target in my marketing. I know that indie devs often struggle with creating 3D models and other assets but do asset generators (specifically the AI ones) something that devs use? And if yes what features are or would be the most valuable. If you want to give me some feedback on my generator it is called Veyraflow, so far only available in European Union due to some tax concerns.

comments.author: Varrianda
comments.body: I have yet to see a 3d game with all AI assets do well, even more so for 2d.
